tree.heading: In General.—
tree.text: A charter under this chapter shall require the charterer, at the charterer’s expense, to—

children.text: keep the chartered vessel in good repair and efficient operating condition; and
make any repairs required by the Secretary of Transportation.

tree.heading: Inspection.—
tree.text: The charter shall provide that the Secretary has the right to inspect the vessel at any time to ascertain its condition.
